bibl.title: P.Oxy. 2174 fr. 5: an Odyssey for Hipponax?
bibl.seg: Enrico Emanuele Prodi, P.Oxy. 2174 fr. 5: an Odyssey for Hipponax?
bibl.note: The fr. 5 of P. Oxy. XVIII, 2174 (= MP3 547; LDAB 1316) probably bears the title of a book of the Odyssey rather than of a poem of Hipponax.
